brief:
Israeli security forces mobilized at Ben Gurion Airport after a bomb threat forced a Fly Dubai aircraft headed to Tel Aviv to divert, the Ma'an news agency reported. The airline received the threat while the plane was in flight, prompting authorities to treat the incident as a security emergency. Emergency protocols were activated at the airport following the aircraft's arrival.

No further details were immediately available on the nature of the threat or whether any suspect had been identified in connection with the incident.
title: Israeli security scrambles after bomb threat grounds Dubai flight to Tel Aviv
